graders.name: drops-filler
graders.pattern: clean, readable|try your best|double-check your work

graders.name: keeps-lint-test
graders.description: The lint and test rule survives.

graders.name: loads-pruning-instructions
graders.description: Process check: The agent read `references/pruning-instructions.md` of the skill, as the References table requires here.

graders.name: polish-loaded
graders.description: Process check: refine-it and shorten-it delivered their instructions; this does not show how they were applied.

graders.name: report
graders.criteria: The final message names each rule it removed, and does not claim to have removed the `npm install` rule, the `config/flags.generated.json` rule, the migrations rule, the push rule, or the lint and test rule.

graders.name: safeguards-meaning
graders.criteria: Judge AGENTS.md. It still forbids running `npm install` at the repository root and limits it to `packages/web`; it still forbids editing `config/flags.generated.json` by hand; it still says migrations in `db/migrations/` are never edited after they merge; it still requires `make lint` and `make test` before a pull request and forbids pushing directly to `main`. Wording may differ.
